title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - ConnectivityConfiguration
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/ConnectivityConfiguration. The connectivityConfiguration class encapsulates the configurable attributes of a ConnectivityServiceOffering. Subclass of InstantiationRequirement per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the InstantiationRequirement model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ConnectivityConfiguration'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

sourceIdentifierA.description: Property/Relationship. InterconnectionPointIdentifier reference of the source service access point. Range is PhysicalInterconnectionPointIdentifier or VirtualInterconnectionPointIdentifier (as a URI reference) or a literal string identifier.

destinationIdentifierZ.description: Property/Relationship. InterconnectionPointIdentifier reference of the destination service access point. Range is PhysicalInterconnectionPointIdentifier or VirtualInterconnectionPointIdentifier (as a URI reference) or a literal string identifier.
